task_title: CF-206: classify a manifest-less shell toolkit as cli in the fleet ops census, and capture the live-file change as a committed patch
task_criteria:
Implement CF-206: the fleet ops census must stop classifying a manifest-less shell toolkit as `docs`.

(a) LIVE CLASSIFIER. From /home/kara/code-factory run `python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/fleet_ops_check.py --project code-factory --json | jq -r '.[0].kind'` — it must print `cli` (it printed `docs` before this change), and `... | jq -r '.[0].evidence.kind_basis'` must start with `shell-toolkit:`. The live file is unversioned, so the change is also captured in the repository.

(b) COMMITTED PATCH. `patches/fleet-ops-shell-toolkit.patch` exists at HEAD and `sha256sum patches/fleet-ops-shell-toolkit.patch` equals the digest quoted in board row CF-206's `worker_summary`. The patch is a diff against the PRISTINE pre-fix script, so it is re-verified against the now-patched live file in reverse: `cd ~/.hermes/scripts && git apply --check --reverse /home/kara/code-factory/patches/fleet-ops-shell-toolkit.patch` must succeed (it succeeds only when the live file equals the patched version).

(c) REGRESSION ARMS (all must hold, proven by the committed fixture harness): a manifest-less tree containing only docs/*.md and no scripts still classifies `docs`; a tree with go.mod plus cmd/ still classifies `cli`; a tree with package.json plus a Dockerfile still classifies `service`; census exit-code semantics are unchanged — rc=0 when no family has a gap, rc=1 when at least one does.

(d) GATES in the repository: `bash scripts/boardctl validate` answers RESULT: OK and `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS at the landed commit.

Do NOT require any fleet count (number of `docs` or `cli` families, number of shell-toolkit families) to equal a literal value — the fleet moves between commits. Grade the classification behaviour, the patch artifact and its digest, and the gates. The board row CF-206 is closed by this commit (status complete, commit_hash bound); the repair itself IS expected in this change.
